chapters: Jano' ba' gu Salomoon gu mar gu Dabii ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx daam.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Salomoon bɨx gu Israeel bopxi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx chiñia' bɨx gu Israeel ɨɨbhidham.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Salomoon bɨɨx bɨx dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x ka't gu Gabaoon; na gu' ka't vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki.
Gu' gu' gu Dabii ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Kîriat-jearim pai' ka't; na gu' ka't vaak zel gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix vɨgɨ jodai ka't gu ñi'ook gu Besaleel gu mar gu Uri gu mar gu ur ka't vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon bɨɨx mii' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Salomoon vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix vɨgɨ jodai ka't vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut makgɨrxi bhaan jix bhai'x maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' jix ñi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix maa.
Ba' jix aa' gu Salomoon gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Dabii gu taat jix gɨ' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' pai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu taat; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu ja'tkam na ja'p oo' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' matda' na ba' jix buus baakɨi vupui bhaan dhi' gu ja'tkam; na gu' chɨkka gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon; na gu' dhi' ka't gu i'ii'ñ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda' tu' gu i'ii'ñ tu' cham bhai' tu' mui'x gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook jix duñia' na ba' tu' matda' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' matda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' gio tu' namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda' cham pai' dhuuk ka't gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' va'k tu' mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon gu Jerusalem jix bhai'x ka't gu Gabaoon vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam kavaayo; gio ba' jix duñia' jix bhai'x jix dhaas jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu Jerusalem na ja'p gu jodai gɨ' u'u kavɨk na ja'p chiiw gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kavaayo bhiibgich gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto na ba' gu Salomoon; na gu' gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' kavaayo bhiibgich.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto jix toja jodai kavaayo chamaam mambhɨɨx; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu eteos na ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ gu kavɨk vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon gu iram gu gɨ'kora' gu Tiro; gio ba' gu vupui na ja'p bɨɨx gu Dabii gu taat na ba' gu vaak jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' no'ñ gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' vupui bhaan na ba' gu takarui' tɨkiix na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu xibh gu xumai gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu vaak no'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' jix gɨ' bhaan bɨx gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' chɨkka ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu tɨkɨr cham jɨ'xdha'; gio ba' chɨkka jix duñia' tu' gu vaak gu ñi'ook na ba' vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' gu chio'ñ jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu jodai' na jix uam jix kavɨk jodai ñakaabma' bɨɨx gu Judaa gu Jerusalem gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk ka't gu Liibano; na gu' tu' tu duukam gu u'u gu Liibano; mi' dhɨr tu duukam bɨɨx.
Na gu' na ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'u na gu' gu vaak no'ñ tu' jix gɨ'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tu duukam gu u'u jix maa gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gɨ' tiriik kai'ñ gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gɨ' kai' vaas gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gɨ' suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gɨ' bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu iram gu gɨ'kora' gu Tiro jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhañ gu Salomoon; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨtda gu iram; gio ba' ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix duu gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' jix maa gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu mar jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n ka't gu iram gu taat.

Jano' ba' gu mar gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Dan gu' gu taat ka't gu Tiro; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu jodai' na jix uam jix kavɨk jodai gu jodai gu u'u ñakaabma'; mi' dhɨr na ba' bɨx bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx gu Jawatan gu Dabii gu taat.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan tu duukam tiriik kai' vaas bɨ'ñdhatu' suudai' u'va tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' no'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Liibano gu u'u tu' gu gɨ' suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu Joppe tu' jix duu bɨɨx ka'm gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon bɨx gu chichio'ñ mi'p gu oidha' gu Israeel mi' dhɨr jix duñia' tu' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu taat jix bɨɨx duu bakia' chamaam mambhɨɨx vaik jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' nɨi'ñchudat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x na ba' jix bhai'x gu kavɨk vaik jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook daam na ba' duñia' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Komensoo gu Salomoon gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jerusalem gu kavɨk gu Moria ka't jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu taat pai' gu Dabii ka't gu Ornaan gu Jebuseo.
Jano' ba' kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook maakobh oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu vaak jix duñia' chamaam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhaan dhaas gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak jix gɨ' bɨɨx gu u'u ka't jix bhaan dhaas jix bhai' jix uam jodai tu' bhaan gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan dhaas gio gu vaak gu jodai a'bhar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix uam jodai ka't jix uam jodai gu Parbaim.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan dhaas gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiki'ñgob bɨɨx jix uam jodai; gio ba'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak pai' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan jix bhai'x gu vaak gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhaan dhaas jix bhai' jix uam jodai gu tanoolh na jix bhai' cha'tmam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' mambhɨɨx jix uam jodai; gio ba' jix bhaan dhaas gio jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook duñia' a'aalh tu jiim jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu ñi'ook; na gu' ka't jixchamaam; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm gu vaak; jano' ba' jixchamaam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ka't jixchamaam; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu vaak; mi' dhɨr ka't jixchamaam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ja'tkam mi'p gu ñi'ook; gio ba' mi'p tɨɨt bɨɨx gu vupui bhaan gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñakaabma' tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duu vupui bhaan gu vaak gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tu jiim jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaas bhaan; gio ba' tu' jix duu gu ñi'ook jix dhaas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu novɨ tu jiim o'nsop; gio ba' gu novɨ tu jiim jup tɨɨt gu Jakîn o'nsop gu Boas.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix vɨgɨ jodai gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu gɨ' suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ga'ra' mambhɨɨx jannulhi'ñ jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't jixchamaam gu ñi'ook xikoolh.
Jano' ba' bɨtaa'n ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax mambhɨɨx novɨ maa'nkar bɨx xikoolh; gio ba' jix duñia' gook gu vaakax bɨɨma'n bɨɨx gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vaakax vaik tas gei'ñ vaik saagi'ñ vaik tas buusñi; gio ba' gu gɨ' suudai' bhaan bɨx bhaan mi'p baasɨ'n.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jannulhi'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook jannulhi'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' vaik jix bhai'x.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio mambhɨɨx suudai' buusñi jix dhaas jixchamaam tu jiim jixchamaam o'nsop na ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan; gu' gu gɨ' suudai' ka't na ba' jix duñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx daa'nkar tai na jix tas jix uam jodai bhaan duñia' jix dhaas vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan jixchamaam tu jiim jixchamaam o'nsop.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Ademaas mambhɨɨx gu vaak na jix bhai' jix dhaas vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan jixchamaam tu jiim jixchamaam o'nsop; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix bhaan dhaas kiki'ñgob jix vɨgɨ jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook bhaan tas buusñi gu ñi'ook saagi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu iram gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu iram gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan ɨɨbhidham gook a'sak na ba' gu ñi'ook gook mi'p tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook na ba' gook mi'p tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan suudai' buusñi.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ' suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax bɨtaa'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx jix duu gu iram gu taat gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Jordaan gu oidha' u'u gat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Sukôt gu Seredat.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Salomoon bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook na gu' cham gaagam gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Salomoon bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix uam jodai gu vaak na jix bhai' bhaan gu takarui' tɨkiix.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daa'nkar tai na jix tas jix uam jodai na jix bhai' na ba' vupui bhaan jurtu'nka'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai na jix bhai'; gio ba' ba'k gu vaak kiki'ñgob jix bhai'x na ba' pai' kiki'ñgob gu vaak vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan jix uam jodai.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Akabada ka't bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon tu'x gu Dabii gu taat ka't; gio ba' jix dhaas jix toja jodai jix uam jodai bɨx gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Salomoon jum daa'ñ gu Jerusalem daraa gu Israeel bɨx chiñia' bopxi'ñ ɨɨbhidham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios kiicham gu Dabii gu Sioon.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs bɨx daraa gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' bhɨɨk kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xidhuu mi'p vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bhɨɨk.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu vaak na jix bhai' kakneer gu vaakax cham gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios pai' gu vaak pai' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook tu jiim kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' na ja'p.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' ɨɨbhidham kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' vupui bhaan gu' cham jix duñia' dɨr mai'; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' cham ka't gu ñi'ook gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees ka't gu ñi'ook gu oreb bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mi' dhɨr moor gu Ejipto.
Na gu' na ja'p jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan moor xidhuu na gu' bɨx jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' cham nukadham mui'kim.

Jano' ba' gu Lebitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Asap gu emaan gu Jedutuun bɨɨma'n bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam jajannulhi'ñ mi'p bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tas buusñi jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' bɨɨx chamaam gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr.

Jano' ba' gu mar gu ñi'ook alabaa'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; na gu' jix bhai' na gu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch na ba' bɨɨx tas; jano' ba' gu vaak jix bhuup jano' ba' toov gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha toov; na gu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Salomoon; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukgam.
Jano' ba' gu Yo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' tu' ba'bhak gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu vupui jix bhai' aa' bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' bɨx gu Israeel ka't tɨɨt.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bɨɨx gu novɨ tu' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu chin gu Dabii gu taat bham.

Jano' ba' dɨr gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu Ejipto matgɨm kiicham bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel na ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak pai' gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' gu chio'ñ jum duu gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Dabii na ba' jum duu bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu taat jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' xoi'kam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' dhi' gu i'ii'ñ.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu mar gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't tu ñi'ook; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' pai' gu Dabii gu taat daakat atooxkor gu Israeel na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Salomoon vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Israeel gu noobh.

Na gu' na gu' gu Salomoon ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam jixchamaam jix duñia' jixchamaam gu ñi'ook vaik ka't gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jix dhaas bhaan tu' kɨkbok vupui bhaan bɨx gu Israeel jix duñia' gu noobh gu tɨkɨr jix aa'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios nɨidhim tu' gu tɨkɨr tu' gu oidha' nuuka'n ñi'ook na jix bhaan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu duukam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu duukam gu Dabii gu taat tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu chin gu' bɨɨx gu novɨ jix duñia' na ja'p gu ñi'ook dhi' gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix nukadham tu duukam gu Dabii gu taat jix duñia' bham; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu chio'ñ vupui bhaan tu' atooxkor gu Israeel gu ma'nkam jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt jiim ñi'ook na tu a'ga na ja'p tu' vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook tu duukam gu Dabii.
Gu' gu' tu'r gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix daa bɨɨx gu chio'ñ gu oidha' gu Miren gu tɨkɨr cham jɨ'xdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' dhi' gu vaak.
Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam soi'm tu duukam soi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu ñi'ook soi'm bɨɨx tu duukam gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu'.
Na gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan dhi' gu vaak gu tanoolh gu tukaa' bhaan pai' tu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook; na soi'm bɨɨx tu duukam gu ñi'ook dhi' pai'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam soi'ñ tu duukam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk dhi' pai' soi'm tu' dɨr gu tɨkɨr dɨr pai' gu vaak na jix bhai'; na gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tɨtmo taan gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk aa' gu ñi'ook daraibu' vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan dhi' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu tɨkɨr tu duukam jix maa jix bhai'x bhaan mo'o gu ñi'ook jir bhai' jix maa jurtu'nka' bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ bhaan tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' vupui bhaan tu' dhi' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu tɨkɨr uañi'ñka' uañi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel jix maat gu oidha' chɨɨdak tattat.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tɨkɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ka't dhuuk uañi'ñ bhaan tu' dhi' pai' gu tɨɨgɨ' uañi'ñ na pai' dhuuk.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr uañi'ñka' uañi'ñ tu duukam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel jix bhai' gu bhóogɨt na ba' maa'n dhuuk bhaan gu oidha' chɨɨdak gu maa'nkar gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu' bhɨɨya' bhiogi' gu oidha' tu' bhɨɨya' gu ñi'ook tu' bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' mia'n obhɨɨ'ñ gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr no'x ko'kdai' ka't.
Jano' ba' bɨx soi'm bɨx soi'ñ jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Israeel no'x tu jiim gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu noobh dhi' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu tɨkɨr dɨr pai' ba'bhak uañi'ñka' maa'n jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt dhaibu gu i'ii'ñ; na gu' tu' jix maati' gu i'ii'ñ gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ; mi' dhɨr.
Na ba' na ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu tanoolh bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' tu' chɨɨdak taata'n tattat.
Jano' ba' gio ja'tkam mii' dhɨr cham ua'tulhi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel bhɨɨya' tɨbiap gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñga'n kuiñcha jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu novɨ jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook tu' dhi' gu vaak.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu tɨkɨr dɨr pai' gu vaak na jix bhai' jix duu jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x gu ñi'ook bhɨɨya' duuñ tu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr; na ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' na ja'p gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu tɨɨgɨ' bhaan dhi' gu vaak tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt tu' tɨip tu' bhaan dhi' kiicham tu' bhaan gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu tɨkɨr soi'm soi'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu chio'ñ cham tu' bhaan kɨɨsa' vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu oidha' obhɨɨ'ñ mia'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' pai' ua'tulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu oidha' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu oidha' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x pai' baabuk gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oidha' tu' chɨɨdak tattat bhaan kiicham bhaan gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu tɨkɨr dɨr pai' gu vaak na jix bhai' soi'm soi'ñ kuiñcha uañi'ñka' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu vupui maatɨt soi'm dhi' pai'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bamii' jano' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨɨpi'ñka' tu' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu kavɨk; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jajannulhi'ñ tulhiiñdha' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan xoi'kam jɨɨgi'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu ñi'ook; gio ba' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Dabii tu duukam.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Salomoon jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai jix dhaav gu tɨkɨr maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak.
Na gu' cham gu ñi'ook baakɨi jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix dhaav gu tai gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu vaak ia'rɨ gu oidha' bhaan o'lhia tɨtdada' gu Jawatan Dios bham; na jix bhai' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' makgɨrxi gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x gu vaakax chamaam gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x kakneer; gio ba' jix duñia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Lebitas bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii na ba' gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch na ba' bɨɨx tas; na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii gu ñi'ook gu novɨ; jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan bɨx gu Israeel ka't tɨɨt.

Na gu' gio jix bhaan duu gu Salomoon tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't vupui bhaan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na gu' ka't maa'nkar tai bhaan; na gu' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix vɨgɨ jodai gu Salomoon ka't gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv gu tanoolh bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel jix gɨ' dɨr ba'k gu amat bɨɨx ka'm gu Ejipto.
Na gu' jix bhai'x gu tanoolh jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan kɨɨv gu tanoolh kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv bhañ gu ja'tkam dhi' jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu Salomoon gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Salomoon gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨx gu Salomoon jix duñia' aagak duñia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' jix ñi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon gu tukaa'; gio ba' tu' naak soi'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tu' dhi' pai' gu vaak gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu tɨkɨr cham ka't dhuuk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oidha' tu' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam bhaan tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu vupui tomaat gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jano' ba' tu' tu jiim dɨr gu tɨkɨr uañi'ñ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jano' no'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui maatɨt soi'm dhi' pai'.
Na gu' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu vaak na ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' gu vupui gu i'ii'ñ no'm na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' na ja'p jix jiim gu Dabii gu taat tu' bɨx tu'x tu' jix duñia' nukadham ñi'ook kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Yo gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Dabii gu taat bham; gio ba' cham gu chio'ñ tu' gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook kavɨk jix duñia' ua'tulhi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' jix maa; gio ba' dhi' gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' vupui bhaan tu' bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu oidha' dhi' gu vaak.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tattat jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios o'lhia; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' bɨx dhi' cham bhai' bhaan.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon ka't gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon jɨ'dɨlh gu iram ka't jix maa dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va gu Salomoon gu Amat gu Soba jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Tadmor oidha' jix gaki bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai'x gu amat.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Bet-oron jiix gu Bet-oron jɨ'dɨlh vaak jodai kiki'ñgob.
Jano' ba' gu Baalat bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon ga'ra'; gio ba' gio bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu ja'tkam kavaayo; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu Salomoon gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem gu Liibano bɨx gu oidha' aapi'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia' gu eteos gu Amorreos gu Pereseos gu ebeos gu Jebuseos cham jix duñia' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu oidha' mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham bɨx gu Salomoon bopxi'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham jix dhaas gu Salomoon tu duukam gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham chiñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam kavaayo.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' mii' dhɨr gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon kiicham gu Dabii gu vaak ka't; na gu' jix aa'; na gu' gu u'vɨ cham gu vaak gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel na gu' mii' dhɨr jix daa pai' tu' kia'mi'ñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' makgɨrxi gu Salomoon maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Moisees tas na jix bhaan vaik mui'kim oi'ñga' maachim gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jurtu'nka' gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' gu Lebitas na ba' vupui bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr ki'ñgob; na gu' ka't jix duñia' gu Dabii gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham moor gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bɨx.

Na gu' na gu' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu tanoolh gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx ka'm gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Salomoon ka't gu Esion-geber gu Elot gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ' suudai' gu oidha' gu Edom.

Na gu' na gu' gu iram ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ tu duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ' suudai' jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx tu duukam gu Salomoon gu Opir jix bhɨɨ mambhɨɨx cha'tmam jix uam jodai aichdhak gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.

Jano' ba' gu Oyendo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Seba gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Salomoon suudai' u'va gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' bɨɨx jix ai gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai gu ñi'ook gu jodai a'bhar na ba' vaak zel gu Salomoon bɨɨx tu ñi'ook; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Salomoon tu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ ga'ra'.
Gu' gu' gu Salomoon gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' matgɨm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Seba matda' gu Salomoon gu vaak ka't.
Jano' ba' koi' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook tu duukam dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jajannulhi'ñ pai' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios cham gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu'r ka't naak gu oidha' tu'x matda'.

Gu' gu' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm tɨbiap gu vupui jix duñia' buupui; gio ba' tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ matda' ka't jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; na gu' tu' daam gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu' ka't naak.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ dhi' ja'tkam tu duukam bɨɨx tas vupui bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam matda'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' tu' na ba' bhaan atooxkor gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bhaan na ba' ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu gɨ'kora' chamaam gu ñi'ook cha'tmam jix uam jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai a'bhar; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk ka't na ja'p jix maa gu Seba gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gio tu duukam gu iram tu duukam gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai gu Opir aichdhak gu u'u gu Algummim gu jodai a'bhar.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gu u'u gu Algummim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu ñi'ook na ba'; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu oidha' gu Judaa ka't buupui gu u'u nɨidhim.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Seba bɨx ka't gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' mi' dhɨr ka't gu oidha' bɨɨx tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai gu Salomoon oi'ñga' ka't gu ñi'ook cha'tmam jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'; gio ba' gio bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Arabia chiñia' gu oidha' jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a jix uam jodai gu ñi'ook maa'n ga'ra' jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai ua'tulhdhidha' gu ñi'ook vaik jix uam jodai; gio ba' jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Liibano.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' atooxkor gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam atooxkor bɨɨx dhaibu' jix uam jodai baasɨ'n pai' gu ñi'ook gook mi'p ju'ñdharan.
Jano' ba' ka't gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan baasɨ'n; gio ba' mɨɨjidha' ka't gu ñi'ook nɨidhim oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' oi'ñdha'.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon ka't jix uam jodai bɨx gu vaak gu Liibano jix uam jodai na jix bhai'; gio ba' gu tanoolh gu Salomoon jix toja jodai cham ka't jix duñia'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Tarsis bɨɨx tu duukam gu iram vaik gu tas jix ai gu Tarsis jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' matda'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu Salomoon matda' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' suulhgia' maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix toja jodai jix uam jodai jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook kavaayo bɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gio gu Salomoon maakobh jix bhai'x kavaayo na ba' kavaayo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x jix dhaas jɨ'dɨlh bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' aapi' bhaan bɨx gu gɨ'kora' dɨr gɨ' suudai' jiim bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' gu Pilisteos bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' jix toja jodai gu Jerusalem na ja'p gu jodai gɨ' u'u kavɨk na ja'p chiiw gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio kavaayo na ba' gu Salomoon gu Ejipto bɨx oidha' gɨ'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salomoon dharka' cham bɨx ua'nak gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ñi'ook na jix aa'dham Jawatan gu Aiias gu Silonita gu ñi'ook gu Iddo bhaan gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu Jerusalem bhaan bɨx gu Israeel oo'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Salomoon bɨɨx tattat gu ñi'ook kiicham gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Roboam gu mar.
Na gu' gu Roboam ka't gu Sikêm na gu' gu Sikêm ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx gu Israeel na ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix kai gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat ka't gu Ejipto pai' ka't jix duñia' kuiñcha gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' mɨjɨ tɨɨt; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Jeroboam bɨx gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Roboam bham.
Jano' ba' gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chulhiiñdha'; gio ba' tu' jano' gu ñi'ook juantu'n gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bɨɨx gu taat tu'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' vaik gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam ka't.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx kɨklhi'ñga'n dhi' vupui bhaan gu Salomoon gu taat na pai' dhuuk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' ñiokda' jix bhai' gu ñi'ook tu'.
Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa kɨklhi'ñga'n jix bhɨɨ bɨɨx biipibop jix duñia' bɨɨx vupui bhaan.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' bham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu taat jix dhaas bhaan no'ch.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' biipibop a'ga jix duñia' bɨɨx tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' daipu' gu ja'tkam tu' tu ñi'ook bham gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chulhiiñdha' gu' tu'; mi' dhɨr daipu'; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu taat.
Na ba' gu taat gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' gu taat bɨɨx tu' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Jeroboam bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Roboam vaik gu tanoolh; gio ba' bhaan gu gɨ'kora' ka't jix duñia' bham; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' vaik gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam kɨklhi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' jurtu'nka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam biipibop bham; gio ba' gu taat tu'; mi' dhɨr gu taat bɨɨx tu' bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam; na gu' kuiñcha ka't gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook ka't tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu Aiias gu Silonita gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ bɨx gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' cham ka't naak jix aa' gu ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n tañia' no'ch bɨɨx gu Dabii tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar gu Isaii gu Israeel maa'n dhi' gu Dabii jano' gu vaak ka't bɨx gu Israeel dhi'.
Gu' gu' jix gɨ'kora' gu Roboam bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel oi'ñka' jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam gu Adoram ga'ra' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ; gu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix koi; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix ai'chdhix gu Israeel gu vaak gu Dabii bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' na ja'p suudai' u'va gu Roboam gu Jerusalem jum daa'ñ gu vaak gu Judaa gu Benjamiin chamaam jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' bhaan gu Israeel gu ñi'ook oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Roboam.
Gu' gu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Semeiias gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Roboam gu mar gu Salomoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bɨx gu Israelitas gu Judaa gu Benjamiin.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan gu ja'tkam; na gu' maa'n gu vaak na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook dhi'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu Jeroboam.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix daa gu Roboam gu Jerusalem jɨ'dɨlh na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Bet-leem gu Etam gu Tekoa.
Jano' ba' gu Bet-sur gu Sokô gu Adullam.
Jano' ba' gu Gat gu Maresa gu Sip.
Jano' ba' gu Adoraim gu Lakîs gu Akekâ.
Jano' ba' gu Sora gu Ajaloon gu ebroon jix duñia' gu Judaa gu Benjamiin jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio jix dhaas suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh kutun kavɨk u'u kavɨk; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa gu Benjamiin mi'p.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas mi'p bɨx gu Israeel jum daa'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam aajidha' gu Judaa gu Jerusalem; na gu' gu Jeroboam gu ma'nkam gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' i'ii'mda' na ba' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n ka't gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Jerusalem na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios tattat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Roboam gu mar gu Salomoon vaik; na gu' vaik gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Roboam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ gu Maalat mar u'vɨ gu Jerimot gu mar gu Dabii gu Abiail mar u'vɨ gu Eliab gu mar gu Esaii.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu Jeus gu Samaria gu Saam.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu Maakâ mar u'vɨ gu Absalom gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abiiyas gu Atai gu Sisa gu Selomit.
Gu' gu' gu Roboam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Maakâ mar u'vɨ gu Absalom bhaan bɨx gu u'vɨ; na gu' jix bhɨɨ mambhɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ jix mar gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Na gu' jix dhaas gu Roboam gu Abiiyas gu mar gu Maakâ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam na gu' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ma'nkam bɨx oi'ñga'n gu Judaa gu Benjamiin bɨx jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk jix maa gu ñi'ook mumua'da' gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Roboam ka't tu jiim oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel.
Na gu' jixchamaam oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam jix tɨ'ɨ gu Sisak gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto bhaan gu Jerusalem na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ kavaayo; gu' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu Ejipto cham ga'ra' jɨɨ'ñdhidha'; mi' dhɨr maachim gu Libios gu Sukienos gu Etiopes.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu Jerusalem.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Semeiias gu Roboam chiñia' gu Judaa mi'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem kuiñcha gu Sisak; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' tɨtda:―Cha'pim tu' gio tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu noobh gu Sisak.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gui'p; gio ba' jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix ñi' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Semeiias bham; gio ba' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr cham; jano' ba' va'k dodhia' cham daak bhaan gu Jerusalem gu novɨ gu Sisak.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook ka't tu duukam; na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Sisak gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto gu Jerusalem jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨx; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a jix uam jodai gu Salomoon ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu pai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu jodai' na jix uam do'ñcho gu noobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ba'k gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios aajidha' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix duñia' daak gu Jawatan Dios jix ai'chdhix na ba' cham cham tu' duu bɨx; gio ba' gio gu Judaa tu'x jix bɨɨx duu xoi'kam.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Roboam jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Roboam oo'm na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem kiicham gu Jawatan Dios bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel na ba' jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ'; mi' dhɨr gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Naama gu Ammonita.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na ba' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu'x gu Roboam tumiiñku gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ua'ñix gu Semeiias jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Iddo gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Roboam gu Jeroboam ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Roboam bɨɨx tattat ka't jix duñia' kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Abiiyas gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Jeroboam jix gɨ'kora' gu Abiiyas bhaan gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' vaik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Mikâiia mar u'vɨ gu Uriel gu Gabaa; mi' dhɨr ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Abiiyas gu Jeroboam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abiiyas bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu Jeroboam bhaan bɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk.
Ba' jix aa' jix búup gu Abiiyas bhaan gu kavɨk gu Semaraim gu kakkavɨk gu Epraim; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeroboam bɨx gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix maa oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bhaan gu Israeel na ba' bɨɨx tas gu ma'nkam ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat tu duukam gu Salomoon gu mar gu Dabii jix búup gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jawatan.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Roboam gu mar gu Salomoon na gu' gu Roboam ka't jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ cham.

Jano' ba' jix duu jano' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu ma'nkam gu Dabii na gu' mui'x namki' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n jix uam jodai gu Jeroboam gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu Lebitas jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ja'tkam oi'ñga'n na ba' no'x bɨɨx tuur kɨɨv gu chuukug ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan cham gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ch gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios cham tɨtda:―Cha'pim; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan gu xibh gu xumai; gio ba' gu takarui' bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' mɨichdhai jix uam jodai bɨɨx na ba' gu xumai; na gu' no'ch jir bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gu' jix duñia' tɨtda:―Cha'pim.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx no'ch mo'o jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk na ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tattat na gu' cham xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' gu Jeroboam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' jix ai; gio ba' kua' vupui bhaan ka't gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa ga'ra' vupui bhaan; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeroboam bɨx gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu Abiiyas gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jiboi'ññor gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu Judaa gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu Abiiyas gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ia'rɨ gu Israeel jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa na gu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tattat.
Jano' ba' chɨ'ɨɨk gu Abiiyas gu Jeroboam jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh gu Bet-el bɨɨx taañpu' gu Jesana bɨɨx taañpu' gu Epraim bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Jeroboam gu tanoolh gu Abiiyas; gio ba' tu' naaka'n gu Jawatan Dios jix koi.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abiiyas; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ jix mar gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Abiiyas gu bhóogɨt ua'nak gu Iddo jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu Durmioo gu Abiiyas bɨɨx tattat ka't jix duñia' kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu mar gu Asa gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Asa jix bhai' jix duñia' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tattat jaisaidhat tu duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa juruuñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' jix duu jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Judaa na gu' ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu oidha' cham ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka'.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa; gio ba' dhi' jɨ'dɨlh vaak jodai bɨɨx gɨ' vaak kiki'ñgob tu' gu oidha'; na gu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' bɨx; jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gio gu Asa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kutun kavɨk u'u kavɨk; gio ba' gu Judaa vaik jix bhai'x gu Benjamiin jix bhai'x kutun kavɨk u'u gat; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix buus bhaan gu Sera gu Etiope bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik; gio ba' suudai' u'va bɨɨx ka'm gu Maresa.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix buus gu Asa bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sepata ju'ñdharan gu Maresa.

Ba' jix aa' tu ñi'ook gu Asa gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨɨx jix gɨ' bɨɨx matgɨm gu kavɨk juraa'n na ba' u'ua'tɨdham; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' na gu' tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' bhaan dhi' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham bhaan tu' gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Etiopes vupui bhaan gu Asa vupui bhaan gu Judaa; gio ba' jiboi'ññor gu Etiopes.

Jano' ba' gu Asa gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't chɨ'ɨɨk bɨɨx ka'm gu Gerar; gio ba' ia'rɨ gu Etiopes bɨɨx ka'm cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ; na gu' jix bɨɨx duu vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ'.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio jɨ'dɨlh xikoolh gu Gerar na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan; na gu' jɨ'dɨlh na gu' ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa bhaan aichdhak mumua'da' kakneer jix ai suulh gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Asariias gu mar gu Obed.

Ba' jix aa' jix buus gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Asa; gio ba' gu Asa bɨx gu Judaa gu Benjamiin; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook ua'tulhi'ñ bɨɨx; jano' ba' tu' ka't gaagam gu ñi'ook; gu' tu' gio kiicha'.
Jano' ba' mui'x gu tanoolh tu' dhi' gu Israeel cham jir bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk chulhiiñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu ñi'ook ka't gaagam.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu ñi'ook cham ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na ba' busaak gu ñi'ook mumua'da' tulhiiñ bhaan bɨx oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu noobh; na cham tu'x jai'ch na ba' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix kai gu Asa gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix aa'dham Jawatan gu Obed jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu oidha' gu Judaa gu Benjamiin jɨ'dɨlh ka't jix duñia' gu kavɨk gu Epraim; gio ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Judaa gu Benjamiin bɨɨx gu Epraim gu Manasees gu Simeoon; na gu' mui'x gu Israeel ñɨi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax kɨɨv jix bhai'x kakneer.
Jano' ba' baap gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios tattat bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' no'x cham tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel vaak jodai jix gɨ' jix ali' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu Judaa jix duñia'; na gu' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨx aagak gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ka't gaagam; jano' ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios jɨɨpi'ñka' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Maakâ gu naan gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa na gu' ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Asa gu ñi'ook bhi'ñbak gu Kedroon.
Gu' gu' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix duñia' gu Israeel gu i'ii'ñ gu Asa ka't jix oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu taat ka't jix bhaan jix toja jodai jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' cham ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa.

Jano' ba' jix duu oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa jix tɨ'ɨ gu Baasa gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bhaan gu Judaa gu Rama na ba' cham jix buus tu' baakɨi gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix buusñi gu Asa jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak vaak ja'tkam bhañ gu Ben-adad gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria ka't gu Damasko bham.

Jano' ba' ka't ñi'ook na jix bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' na ja'p ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu taat; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix toja jodai jix uam jodai na ba' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu Baasa gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ben-adad bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa bhañ chugi'ñ jɨ'dɨlh gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Ion gu Dan gu Abel-maim jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Neptalii.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ dhi' gu Baasa jix utu'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Rama gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu Judaa bhɨɨk gu Rama gu jodai gu u'u bɨɨx gu Baasa gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Gibaa gu Mispa.

Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va gu anani gu ñi'ook gu Asa gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria cham tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria tu' gu noobh.
Na gu' gu Etiopes gu Libios cham jix duñia' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu ja'tkam kavaayo bɨɨx bɨx na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu noobh.
Na gu' na gu' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu oidha' na ba' namki' gu i'ii'ñ na ba' bɨɨx; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi'; na gu' jix duñia' bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan tu'.
Na gu' jix bhai'x gu Asa bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak kuupa' na gu' ka't kuiñcha dhi'; gio ba' gu Asa mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook dhɨt gu ja'tkam.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Asa dharka' u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu Asa tɨɨt na ba' jiix ko'kdai' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Asa bɨɨx tattat jix koi oi'ñga' oo'm maa'n gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook pai'm ka't gu ñi'ook na ba' kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɇɇka' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Josapat gu mar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨx jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu Judaa jɨ'dɨlh gu Epraim gu taat gu Asa ka't jix duñia'.
Na gu' ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Josapat na gu' jix jiim dharka' gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii gu taat cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baales.
Gu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu taat jix jiim gu ñi'ook cham bhaan buimɨi gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu novɨ bɨx gu Judaa jix maa gu Josapat; gio ba' jix duñia' namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' vaik oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' bhañ chiñia' gu Ben-ail gu Obdiias gu Sakâriias gu Nataniel gu Mikêas na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu Lebitas gu Semeiias gu Netaniias gu Sebadiias gu Asael gu Semiramot gu Jonataan gu Adoniias gu Tobiias gu Tobadoniias gu Lebitas; gio ba' bɨɨx gu Elisama gu Joram jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Judaa ua'tulhdhidha' baidhak u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' oi'ñga'n mi'p xikoolh gu Judaa; na cham bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Josapat.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Pilisteos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josapat bopxi'ñ jix toja jodai; gio ba' gu Arabes gio aichdhak kɨɨv jix bhai'x gu chuukug kɨɨv jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook chiiw.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Josapat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' pai'x gu Judaa jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mumua'da' buimɨi jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham gu bhóogɨt jix kavɨk gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' dhi' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' bhaan gu vaak tattat; gio ba' gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Adna bɨɨx vaik jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joanaan bɨɨx jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amasiias gu mar gu Sikri ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Benjamiin gu Eliada gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josabad bɨɨx chamaam jix bhai'x na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix duñia' tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Judea.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu Josapat namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu Akâb.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaav gu Akâb gu Samaria; gio ba' gu Akâb mumua'da' kakneer gu vaakax na ba' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr jum duu bɨɨx gu Ramot gu Galaad.

Ba' jix aa' gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ramot gu Galaad jix aa'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p tu' gio tu'; jano' ba' na ja'p gu ja'tkam gio gu ja'tkam; gio ba' bɨndak bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jum daa'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Ramot gu Galaad dhi' tu' gui'p; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Josapat; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix aa' gu Josapat; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu'x jai'ch gu chio'ñ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu' tu' na gu' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' jix bhai' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tas cham bhai'; jano' ba' dhi' gu Mikêas gu mar gu Imla; gio ba' jix aa' gu Josapat; mi' dhɨr cham tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jup tɨɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu vupui gu Mikêas gu mar gu Imla.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa mi'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n atooxkor jajannulhi'ñ; gio ba' mi'p ka't ba'k ki'ñgob gu Samaria bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu Sedekîas gu mar gu Kênaana ka't gu ñi'ook a'aa' jix kavɨk jodai chɨtda; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Siros bɨɨx ka'm cham tu' duu bɨx.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix duñia' gio bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Ramot gu Galaad tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' mattuda' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt gu Mikêas bham; gio ba' gu Miren gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu chin jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr tu' soi'ñ gu ñi'ook ka't na ja'p maa'n tu ñi'ook xoi'kam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Mikêas; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Mikêas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Ramot gu Galaad dhi' tu' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr boopoya' ka't kapbhai' gu noobh.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mui'kim tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios cham tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook tu'r.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' buupui bɨx gu Israeel vaak na jix bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakkavɨk na ja'p kakneer cham bipia'dam; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam cham namki' gu Jawatan; gio ba' maa'n bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu vaak.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Josapat; gio ba' cham tu' ka't tu' tu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam gu ñi'ook cham bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' buupui gu Jawatan Dios daakat atooxkor bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr ka't gu novɨ tu jiim o'nsop.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel na ba' jix duñia' gu Ramot gu Galaad maa'n chɨtda.
Ba' jix aa' gu' jix buus gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chin bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; jano' ba' gio; gio ba' jix buus tu jiim.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chin dhi' ja'tkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' cham bhai' gu ñi'ook tu'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sedekîas gu mar gu Kênaana gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' naaka'n gu Mikêas gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jix ai'chdhix tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Mikêas jix aa'; na pai' dhuuk gu Miren tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk tu' ba'k gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ba'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mikêas gu Amoon gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' kiicham gu Joas gu mar gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr kuupa' bɨɨx gu takarui' gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm tu' jix duñia' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Mikêas; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' tu ñi'ook tu'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam bɨx.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Ramot gu Galaad.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Josapat; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' baakɨi; gu' tu' jajannulhi'ñ; jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel chɨbiapui.
Jano' ba' ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ga'ra' baidhak bham; gio ba' cham bɨɨx tu' bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josapat gui'p; gio ba' dhi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr na ba'; gu' gu Josapat tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix ai'chdhix gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' ñɨi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu ñi'ook naaka'n gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jano' ba' jix aa'; na gu' gu novɨ yooxi' na gu' dhi' cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh juruuñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tɨɨt gu ñi'ook gu Siros bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai; gu' jix koi gu tas.
Jano' ba' gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu vaak gu Jerusalem.
Ba' jix aa' jix buus gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jeuu gu ñi'ook gu mar gu anani gu gɨ'kora' gu Josapat; gio ba' gu ñi'ook u'ua'tɨdham gu Jawatan Dios daak gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan tu'.
Na gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gaagam tu' jix bhai' tu'x na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix daa gu Josapat gu Jerusalem; gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam busaak gu ja'tkam dɨr gu Beer-seba bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu Jawatan Dios tattat.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Judaa bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam; na gu' cham pai' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook pai' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' ka't bɨɨx gu ñi'ook choo'n gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios cham cham tu'x jai'ch tu' na cham jir bhai' tu'.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas gio gu Josapat gu Jerusalem dhɨt gu Lebitas jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan tattat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel na ba' ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios na ba'; gio ba' suulh gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx choo'n gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx tu'r bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx bhai'.

Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha daraibu' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam jɨ'dɨlh tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñi'ook na tu a'ga ñi'ook kavɨk jix duñia' cham bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na gu' cham daak bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amariias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't bɨx gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Sebadiias gu mar gu Ismael gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu vaak gu Judaa bɨx gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gio gu Lebitas ka't gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix duñia'; na gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu'x ka't gu ma'nkam gu Moab gu Ammoon bɨɨx gu Ammonitas tɨɨtɨs bhaan gu Josapat bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa aa'ñdham gu Josapat bham; gio ba' bhaan tu' jupaabkamu'n jix gɨ' baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' gu Siria; mi' dhɨr gu asasoon-tamar gu Engedi.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' choo'n; gio ba' jix dhaas gu Josapat gu vupui na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Judaa na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gio bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa tɨɨtɨs gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas jano' ba' gu Josapat tɨɨt gu masad gu Judaa gu Jerusalem gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix vɨɨk.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios taata'n tattat cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr tu' bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Gentes cham gu novɨ jix duñia' gu kavɨk bɨxchu'x cham cham tu'x jai'ch tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel chɨɨdak gu kai' gu Abraam na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' xidhuu gu tɨɨgɨ' bham.

Na gu' tu' cham bhai' daraibu' bhaan no'ch gu kuchii sɨlhka'n gu ñi'ook bhiogi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan dhi' gu vaak vupui bhaan tu' na gu' gu tɨɨgɨ' dhi' gu vaak bopxi'ñ duuñ tu' u'ua'tɨda'.
Na pai' dhuuk jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Moab gu kavɨk gu Seir gu oidha' cham gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk aajidha' gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dan bai'ñpu' gu maa'nkar tu' chɨɨdak gu ñi'ook.

Na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na gu' no'ch cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu kavɨk bhaan gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' jupaabkamu'n bhaan no'ch; gio ba' cham gu vupui gu' tu' gu Dios gu vupui.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Judaa ka't tɨɨt vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx a'aalh gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Jaasiel gu mar gu Sakâriias gu mar gu Benaiias gu mar gu Jeiel gu mar gu Mataniias gu Lebita gu ma'nkam gu Asap bhaan suudai' u'va gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu masad.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Judaa bɨx gu ñi'ook gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Josapat; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan dhi' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'; na gu' cham bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu xibh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Sis chɨɨmɨlhdhapu' ju'ñdharan jix duu va'k oidha' jix gaki gu Jeruel.

Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook dhi'; gio ba' na ba' dhi' tulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Judaa gu Jerusalem cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha' tu'; jano' ba' gu xibh bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Josapat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui gu oidha' bɨx gu Judaa gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios o'lhia gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Lebitas gu ma'nkam gu Koat gu ma'nkam gu Koree na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh moor oidha' jix gaki gu Tekoa; gio ba' jix buus gu Josapat kua' tɨɨt jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Judaa gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios boopoya' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan boopoya'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ja'tkam jix dhaas dhɨt gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' busaak gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; na gu' tas na jix gɨ' gu Jawatan Dios na gu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' na ja'p kua'da' bɨɨx tu ñi'ook bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook jix dhaas gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Moab gu kavɨk gu Seir gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam aajidha' bhaan gu Judaa.
Na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Moab jix búup bhaan gu kavɨk gu Seir na ba' kooda' cham tu' duu; gio ba' na ja'p a'lhiok gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Seir gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chajaañ duiñchu'.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki bhaan; gu' gu oidha' koko'kam ka't.

Jano' ba' bai'ñpu' jano' ba' gu Josapat gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mumua'da' namkɨm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jajannulhi'ñ na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' cham; na gu' vaik gu tanoolh na gu' ka't jix jai'.
Jano' ba' maakobh gu tanoolh jum daa'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Beraka; na gu' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Beraka bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' bɨx gu Judaa gu Jerusalem gu Josapat mo'o suulh na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem bɨɨx na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' mii' dhɨr gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Josapat jix duñia' jɨɨpi'ñka'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu Josapat bhaan gu Judaa; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Asuba mar u'vɨ gu Sili.
Jano' ba' jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu Asa gu taat cham gu ñi'ook duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jix duñia'; na gu ja'tkam cham ka't gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tattat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josapat dharka' gu ñi'ook gu Jeuu gu mar gu anani u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu'x gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Okôsiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ka't jix maa.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨɨx chu'p na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaai'n gu Tarsis; gio ba' gu Esion-geber.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Elieser gu mar gu Dodaba gu Mareosa jix duñia' bhaan gu Josapat bham; na gu' gu ñi'ook chu'p bɨɨx gu Okôsiias gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam buimɨi; mi' dhɨr cham tu' gu Tarsis.
Jano' ba' gu Durmioo gu Josapat bɨɨx tattat gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tattat kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Joram gu mar.

Jano' ba' dhi' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Josapat gu Asariias gu Jeiel gu Sakâriias gu Asariias gu Mikâel gu Sepatiias; gio ba' bɨx dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu taat ka't jix maa mui'x juana' jix uam jodai jix toja jodai tu'x a'bhar jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Judaa; na gu' gu' ka't jix maa oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Joram na gu' ka't maa'nkam mar.
Jano' ba' ka't jix bhai'x gu Joram oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu taat; gio ba' jix duu jix kavɨk mu'aa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam dhɨt chiñia' gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jix duu jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel na ja'p gu vaak gu Akâb; na gu' ga'ra' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ mar u'vɨ gu Akâb tu' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' duu gu vaak gu Dabii kuiñcha ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu Dabii ka't gu ñi'ook na gu' ka't tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Idumea na ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu Judaa jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' bhaan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Joram bɨɨx chiñia' baidhak bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix búup gu tukaa' tu' naaka'n gu Idumeos mia'n bɨx.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Edom gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu Judaa bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gio gu ñi'ook gu Libna na ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu novɨ; na gu' ka't tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu Jawatan Dios tattat.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu kakkavɨk gu Judaa tu' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Eliiyas am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu taat tu' tu ñi'ook; na gu' cham gu bhóogɨt gu Josapat gu taat tu' gu bhóogɨt gu Asa gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' va'k gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Judaa gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem na ja'p gu vaak gu Akâb; gio ba' jix koi gu ja'tkam ja'tkam vaak gu taat jix duñia' tutkɨ tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' gu ma'nkam gu u'vɨ bɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' bɨɨx mumua'da' dudua'ñ bɨɨx ko'kdai' ba'k bɨɨx ka'm ba'k tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha ko'kdai' gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Joram gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Pilisteos gu Arabes mi'p ju'ñdharan gu Etiopes.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan gu Judaa tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu u'vɨ; na cham gu ñi'ook gu mar gu ñi'ook gu Joakâs jix ali' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr bɨx dhi' gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n ba'k ko'kdai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' ka't bhɨi gu tanoolh bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook ba'k moor bɨɨx ko'kdai' vaak jodai ko'kdai' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' cham jix duu gu ja'tkam na ja'p ka't gu ñi'ook tattat.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' ka't cham; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook kiicham gu Dabii gu' cham pai'm gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem jix duu gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Okôsiias gu mar jix ali'; na gu' ka't tɨbiap bɨɨx gu Arabes yooxi' ka't jix koi bɨx; mi' dhɨr jix gɨ'kora' gu Okôsiias gu mar gu Joram gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Okôsiias kua'da' gu ñi'ook ka't oo'm gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ'kora' oi'ñga' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Ataliia mar u'vɨ gu Omri.
Jano' ba' gio jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu Akâb; na gu' gu naan jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu vaak gu Akâb; na gu' mi' dhɨr koi'm gu taat jix duñia' na ba' jai'chdhɨlhia'.
Jano' ba' jix jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx gu Joram gu mar gu Akâb gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bhaan gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria gu Ramot gu Galaad pai' gu Siros gu Joram.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu Jesreel gu ñi'ook gu Rama bɨɨx gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria; na gu' jix dhaav gu Asariias gu mar gu Joram gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Joram gu mar gu Akâb gu Jesreel na gu' ka't ka'ook.

Jano' ba' dhi' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu Okôsiias jum duu bai'ñpu' gu Joram; na gu' tɨbiap jix buus bɨɨx gu Joram bhaan gu Jeuu gu mar gu Nimsi gu Jawatan Dios ka't Xoi'kam na ba' gu vaak gu Akâb.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Jeuu bɨɨx gu vaak gu Akâb gu ñi'ook chiñia' gu Judaa gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu Okôsiias gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Okôsiias mu'aa.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Okôsiias ka't gu jodai' na jix uam gu Samaria gu ñi'ook aichdhak gu Jeuu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' jix maa na gu' gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu mar gu Josapat gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu i'ii'ñ; jano' ba' gu vaak gu Okôsiias cham ga'ra' gu ñi'ook na ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Ataliia gu naan gu Okôsiias ñɨi'ñ gu mar ka't jix koi jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu kai' vaak ja'tkam gu vaak gu Judaa.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Josabet mar u'vɨ gu gɨ'kora' jix bhɨɨ gu Joas gu mar gu Okôsiias gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; na gu' gu Josabet mar u'vɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Joram gu u'vɨ gu Joiada jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na gu' ka't gu ja'tkam gu Okôsiias vupui bhaan gu Ataliia cham.
Jano' ba' juruuñ bɨɨx gu jodai' na jix uam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Ataliia gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' kɨɨv oi'ñga' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joiada jix bhɨɨ baidhak ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Asariias gu mar gu Jeroam gu Ismael gu mar gu Joanaan gu Asariias gu mar gu Obed gu Maasiias gu mar gu Adaiias gu Elisapat gu mar gu Sikri.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa jum daa'ñ gu Lebitas bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa chiñia' gu Israeel tɨɨtɨs gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jix duu bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu mar gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios juraa'n tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' duñia'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook ba'k kia'pɨx no'm bɨɨx jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' baasɨ'n ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas tu jiim; na gu' suulhgia' jɨjɨkgɨm na gu'; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu ñi'ook gu novɨ; gio ba' no'x ba'k gu vaak; na pai' dhuuk dhi' bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' na pai' dhuuk ba'k na pai' dhuuk.

Jano' ba' gu Lebitas bɨx gu Judaa jix duu bɨx na ja'p ka't jix duñia' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Joiada; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kia'pɨx jix buus juanda'; na gu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Joiada cham jix maa.
Jano' ba' jix maa gio jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Joiada gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'u kavɨk gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii mi'p gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ja'tkam ua'tulhdhidha' maa'n gu kuchii gu novɨ dɨr gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' bɨx.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaas kuruun chuut tu' jix duu gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Joiada gu ma'nkam tu jiim bham; mi' dhɨr gu tai gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Ataliia jix kai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' suudai' u'va gu ja'tkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tɨɨgɨk jix ñi' gu gɨ'kora' ka't ju'ñdharan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ba'k chiñia' kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk ju'ñdharan gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' jix duñia' gu mar alabaa'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Ataliia jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr.

Ba' jix aa' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan daañxi'ñdha' gu Joiada gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' jix buusñi mai'; mi' dhɨr; na gu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't jix duñia' cham gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ ka't ba'k ki'ñgob kavaayo gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Joiada ñi'ook na jix bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' chɨbiapui bɨx gu ja'tkam vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Baal jix duñia' gio jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' tu' jix duu bapaalh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mu'aa vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Mataan jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Baal.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joiada gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bhaan gu Dabii ka't gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan na ja'p ua'nak ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees bɨɨx xoi'kam jurtu'nka' gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiki'ñgob gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' matgɨm gu bhóogɨt ba'k ñaanbi'.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bai'ñpu' bɨɨx ka'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ ki'ñgob jix gɨ' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' jix dhadhaa gu gɨ'kora' bhaan atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' kiicham juruuñ jix koi a'lhiok gu Ataliia.
Na pai' dhuuk gu Siete gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Joas na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook oo'm jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Sibia gu Beer-seba.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Joas gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu tanoolh gu Joiada jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu Joiada gook gu u'vɨ; gio ba' jix mar gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't gu Joas jix duñia' aagak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jum daa'ñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa tuumiñ bɨx gu Israeel na ba' oi'ñga' ka't gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook; gu' gu Lebitas cham jix dhaas gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' jup tɨɨt gu Joiada gɨ'kora' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas gu Judaa gu Jerusalem vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu maa'nkar gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ataliia gu ma'nkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' duiñxim bɨx tu'x gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' jix dhaas mai' ki'ñgob gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa gu Jerusalem gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Israeel oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' bɨx chiñia' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' bɨɨx ka'm.

Na pai' dhuuk na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' jir bɨx bhai' gu gɨ'kora' gu novɨ gu Lebitas na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' ka't jix jai' tuumiñ gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' jix bhai'x pai'; gio ba' bhaan gu tanoolh jix jai' tuumiñ.
