Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Joiada bhaan gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios tɨ'ya' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu noobh ka't gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk a'lhiok gu ñi'ook aichdhak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tuumiñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Joiada tu' jix duu na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix uam jodai jix toja jodai; gio ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu tanoolh gu Joiada.
Gu' gu' gu Joiada gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix koi jix bhai'x gu tanoolh; na pai' dhuuk chamaam gu ñi'ook ka't na pai' dhuuk jix koi.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook kiicham gu Dabii bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' na gu' ka't gu ñi'ook xoi'kam bɨɨx gu Israeel na ba' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix koi gu Joiada tɨɨtɨs chiñia' gu Judaa tu' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix kai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios tattat; gio ba' daak suudai' u'va bhaan gu Judaa gu Jerusalem dhi' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' bhañ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gu' cham jix kai.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sakâriias gu mar gu Joiada jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan kua' bhaan gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham ɨlhdham xoi'kam; na gu' tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu Jawatan Dios gio kiicha'.
Gu' gu' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu jodai gu gɨ'kora' naadat gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' chɨ'ñchoka' gu gɨ'kora' gu Joas xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu taat gu Joiada ka't gu ñi'ook bɨɨx va'k mu'aa gu mar; gio ba' jix aa' koi; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñga' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Siria; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Judaa gu Jerusalem gu ja'tkam bɨx gu ñi'ook mɨjɨ bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Damasko.

Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Siria ka't tɨbiap bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu noobh ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu bhóogɨt; na gu' tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu Jawatan Dios tattat; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu Joas jix duu ñi'ook na jir bhai'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Siros gu ñi'ook mumua'da' dudua'ñ; gio ba' bhaan tu duukam kuiñcha gu ɨ'ɨr gu ma'nkam gu Joiada jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu' jix koi; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook kiicham gu Dabii gu' cham gu ñi'ook pai'm gu gɨ'kora'.
Na gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jix bɨɨx duu gu Sabad gu mar gu Simat gu Ammonita gu Josabad gu mar gu Simrit gu Moabita.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam jix mui' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Amasiias gu mar.
Na pai' dhuuk gu Beintikinko gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Amasiias na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Joaddan gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't tu jiim oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' mu'aa tu duukam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix koi gu gɨ'kora' gu taat.

Gu' gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam bhaan ua'nak ñi'ook na tu a'ga u'uan gu Moisees pai' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix bham; gio ba' cham koi tattat gu ma'nkam tu' gu ma'nkam tattat; gu' maa'n koi uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Amasiias gu Judaa bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaas bopxi'ñ bɨx gu Judaa gu Benjamiin; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook jiix jix bɨɨx duu bakia' vaik jix bhai'x na ba' jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham ko'kmarak u'u kavɨk kutun kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook cha'tmam jix toja jodai.

Gu' gu' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨndak ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham bɨɨx gu Israeel tu' bɨɨx bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Epraim.
Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' duñia' tu' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk na ba'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Amasiias gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cha'tmam jix maa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix jai' dhi'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Amasiias jix ai'chdhix gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam ka't tɨbiap gu Epraim na ba' bhaai'n gu vaak; gio ba' bhaan gu Judaa suulh gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' gu Amasiias jix buusñi gu ja'tkam suudai' u'va gu Sal; gio ba' tu' naaka'n gu ma'nkam gu Seir mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ko'iix mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x bhɨɨk gu jodai' na jix uam bɨx jix duu bapaalh.

Na gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amasiias ka't jix duñia' na gu' cham bhaai'n bɨɨx bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa dɨr gu Samaria bɨɨx ka'm gu Bet-oron tu' vaik jix bhai'x jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amasiias gu ñi'ook gu Idumeos gio baidhak gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Seir na ba' gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'iich gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Amasiias bhañ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam cham jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu noobh.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan dhi' tu'x; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Deejate gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' na gu' gu ñi'ook dhi' cham.
Jano' ba' gu Amasiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhañ a'ga gu Joas gu mar gu Joakâs gu mar gu Jeuu gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Joas gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bhañ a'ga gu Amasiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Liibano bhañ gɨ' u'u kavɨk ka't gu Liibano bham; mi' dhɨr jix maa mar u'vɨ gu mar gu u'vɨ; jano' ba' gu vaakax mi'p gu Liibano gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Edom; mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ na ba' tas na jix gɨ'; jano' ba' jano' jix duñia' gu vaak; gio ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook tu' cham bhai' na ba' tu' gu Judaa bɨndak.
Gu' gu' gu Amasiias cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' ka't gu Jawatan Dios kɨɨsa' gu noobh na gu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios gu Edom.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Joas gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amasiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Bet-semes gu Judaa.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa vupui bhaan gu Israeel maa'n dhi'.

Jano' ba' gu Joas gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Bet-semes gu Amasiias gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu mar gu Joas gu mar gu Joakâs gu Jerusalem; gio ba' vaak jodai gu Jerusalem dɨr ki'ñgob gu Epraim bɨɨx ka'm ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ bɨx jix uam jodai jix toja jodai bɨx gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Obed-edom gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam chiñia' gu Samaria.
Jano' ba' jix oidha' gu Amasiias gu mar gu Joas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi' dhɨr koi'm gu Joas gu mar gu Joakâs gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amasiias dharka' cham ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' dɨr mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Amasiias jix ai'chdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Jerusalem; gio ba' dhaibu jix duñia' gu Lakîs mɨjɨ bhaan gu Lakîs.
Jano' ba' aichdhak kavaayo gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tattat kiicham gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Judaa jix bhɨɨ gu Ussiias ka't mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu Amasiias gu taat.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Elot gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' jix koox bɨɨx tattat.
Na pai' dhuuk mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Ussiias na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gook jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Jekôliia gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x ka't gu ñi'ook gu Amasiias gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh gu Sakâriias gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Pilisteos vaak jodai gu Gat vaak jodai gu Jabnia vaak jodai gu Asdod; gio ba' pai'x jɨ'dɨlh gu Asdod gu oidha' gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios u'ua'tɨdham bhaan gu Pilisteos bhaan gu Arabes oi'ñka' gu Gur-baal bhaan gu Ammonitas.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Ammonitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ussiias gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨɨx ka'm ba'k gu Ejipto; na gu' ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu Ussiias gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem ju'ñdharan ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan ki'ñgob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ju'ñdharan; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki jix kupi'ook mumua'da'; na gu' jix duñia' mui'x na ja'p; mi' dhɨr gu ux na tu ibai' gu kakkavɨk na ja'p; na gu' ka't.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gio gu Ussiias gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan mi'p gu novɨ gu Jeiel gu Maasiias gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu novɨ gu ananiias maa'n chiñia' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' bɨx jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk ka't gook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ suulhgia' ka't ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bhɨɨ'ñdham vaik kɨɨv jix bhai'x jix kavɨk na ba' gu gɨ'kora' bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ussiias na ba' bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ñi'ook u'u kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu jodai.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n na gu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx ka'm duñia' jix kavɨk.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx ka'm; na gu' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios baakɨk vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' chɨbiapui bhaan jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Asariias bɨɨx jix bhai'x jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Ussiias gui'p; gio ba' cham tu' gu ñi'ook gu Ussiias gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix bhaan na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr jix buus xidhuu cham tu' ka't na ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ussiias ga'ra' gu novɨ na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' dhi' daak bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan dua'ñdha' jix buus jix bhai'x vupui bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ju'ñdharan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Asariias gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨx jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan dua'ñdha' ka't jix bhai'x; gio ba' tu' jix duu jix buus jix duñia' mii' dhɨr pai'; na gu' gio jix maa jix buus na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ussiias ka't gakiidha' bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh koi'm jix daa gu vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gakiidha' ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Joatam gu mar jix duñia' gu vaak vaak ja'tkam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ja'tkam gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ussiias dharka' ua'na gu Isaiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu mar gu Amoos.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Ussiias bɨɨx tattat gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tattat yooxi' pai'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gui'p; mi' dhɨr gakiidha'; jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu Joatam gu mar pai'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu Beintikinko gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Joatam na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Jerusa mar u'vɨ gu Sadok.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x ka't gu ñi'ook gu Ussiias gu taat jix duñia' cham chɨbiapui vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu ki'ñgob jix gɨ' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios vaak jodai gu kavɨk pai'x jix jai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh gɨ' kavɨk gu Judaa gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gio jix duñia' bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix maa gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon mii' dhɨr oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook cha'tmam jix toja jodai mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x gu jodai' na jix uam tiriik mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x kai' vaas; mi' dhɨr dhi' jix maa gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gook oi'ñga' vaik.
Na gu' gu Joatam ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Joatam bɨx bhɨɨ'ñdham gu bhóogɨt ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu Judaa.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Joatam bɨɨx tattat gu ñi'ook kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Akâs gu mar.

Na pai' dhuuk gu Beinte gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Akâs na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; gu' cham jix duu gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu Dabii gu taat.
Jano' ba' jix duu va'k jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baales.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu ma'nkam gu innom gu ma'nkam gu tai jurtu'nka' chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios ka't baas vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨtaa'n bɨx gu u'u.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu noobh gu gɨ'kora' gu Siros jix gɨ' bhɨɨk gu Damasko; gio ba' ka't gio dhagia' gu noobh gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bɨɨx.
Na gu' na gu' gu Peka gu mar gu Remaliias mu'aa gu Judaa gu tanoolh chamaam gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu Jawatan Dios tattat.
Jano' ba' gu Asimismo gu Sikri gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Epraim mu'aa gu Maasiias gu mar gu gɨ'kora' gu Asrikam gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu Elkana gook mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x gu u'vɨ aichdhak gu Samaria.

Ba' jix aa' ka't jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Obed jix buus vupui bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham na pai' dhuuk gu Samaria; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tattat bhaan gu Judaa tu' dhagia' gu noobh; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jix koi bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨkɨr tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' jix duñia' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Judaa gu Jerusalem tu duukam; gu' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' tɨip gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ja'tkam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix búup jano' ba' dhɨt gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Epraim gu Asariias gu mar gu Joanaan gu Berekîas gu mar gu Mesillemot gu Esekîas gu mar gu Sallum gu Amasa gu mar gu adlai bhaan aajidha' bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x; na gu' uañi'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan no'ch; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan uañi'ñ bhaan uañi'ñ jix gɨ' chulhiiñdha' gu ñi'ook i'iich bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan chiñia' bɨx.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi'p dha'npak; gio ba' jix maa jugi i'i tu jiim gu ñi'ook bɨx bhɨɨk bɨɨx ka'm gu Jerikoo kiicham gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x mia'n gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr suulh gu Samaria.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Akâs gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu Idumeos tɨbiap gu Judaa baabuk gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Pilisteos jix daa vaak na jix bhaan jɨ'dɨlh saagi'ñ gu Judaa jix daa jix duñia' gu Bet-semes gu Ajaloon gu Gederot gu Sokô bɨɨx taañpu' gu Timna gio bɨɨx taañpu' gu Gimso bɨɨx taañpu'; gio ba' oi'ñka'.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuiñcha gu Akâs gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; na gu' ka't gu Judaa gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va bhaan gu Tilgat-pilneser gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Akâs gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak vaak ja'tkam chiñia' na ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Akâs gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu Damasko gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Siria tu' gio maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan na ba'; mi' dhɨr xoi'kam jix bɨɨx duu suulhgia' bɨx gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Akâs gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios tu' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jerusalem bɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa na ba' gu Jawatan Dios daak gu Jawatan Dios tattat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu bhóogɨt dharka' ua'nak u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Akâs bɨɨx tattat gu ñi'ook kiicham gu Jerusalem; gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai'm gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Esekîas gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu Esekîas kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Abiia mar u'vɨ gu Sakâriias.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x ka't gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu taat.
Jano' ba' maa'n oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n jix kupi'ook kiki'ñgob gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix ai jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas jum daa'ñ ɨrban gu ux na tu ibai'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas jix bhaan jano' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios tattat jix buusñi xidhuu.

Na gu' na gu' taata'n tattat jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu ñi'ook gu vupui vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios suulh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob jix duñia' tɨtɨɨya; gio ba' cham tu' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan xidhuu gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daak gu Jawatan Dios tu' tɨbiap bhaan gu Judaa gu Jerusalem tu' dhagia' na ja'p bɨɨx gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam taata'n tattat jix duñia' taata'n gu ma'nkam taata'n ma'nkam u'uuvɨ taata'n gu u'vɨ dhi'.
Jano' ba' jano' tu' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel na ba' dɨlhkob no'ch gu ñi'ook i'iich.
Na gu' gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham jano' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' vupui bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Lebitas jix búup gu Maat gu mar gu Amasai gu Joel gu mar gu Asariias gu ma'nkam gu Koat; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu Kis gu mar gu Abdi gu Asariias gu mar gu Jealeleel; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon gu Joa gu mar gu Simma gu Edeen gu mar gu Joa.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elisapaan gu Simri gu Jeiel; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asap gu Sakâriias gu Mataniias.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu emaan gu Jeiel gu Simi; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jedutuun gu Semeiias gu Ussiel.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jum daa'ñ gu ja'tkam jix bhaan baap jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' baakɨk jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Lebitas na ba' jix buusñi mai' bhi'ñbak gu Kedroon.
Jano' ba' kua'da' jix bhaan maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n tɨɨtɨs gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhaan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh maa'n jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas gui'p; gio ba' tu' bɨx gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨx gu vaak na jix bhai' tɨkiix bɨɨx bɨx.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Akâs na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu xibh gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas jum daa'ñ gu ñi'ook kiicham jix tɨ'ɨ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv gu chuukug kɨɨv ali' karneer kɨɨv chiiw na ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' xidhuu gu Judaa; gio ba' jix aa' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ɨ'ɨr tu jiim bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu chuukug tu jiim gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr ali' karneer tu jiim gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui ɨ'ɨɨr vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaas bhaan gu noobh.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' bɨx gu Israeel; na gu' bɨx gu Israeel jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas gio gu Lebitas gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu Gad gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; na gu' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu Lebitas mi'p bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Esekîas maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook kua'da' maa'nkar tai bhaan kua'da' gio bhai' ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' alabaa'n gu ñi'ook gu mar gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' bɨx bɨɨx mi'p o'lhia.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas chiñia' gui'p gu Lebitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu Asap gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jix gɨ' bhai' ñi'ook tu' o'lhia.

Ba' jix aa' kai'ch:―Dho gu Esekîas; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' jix bhaan jano' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr makgɨrxi'ñdha' bhai' ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' makgɨrxi'ñdha' bhai' ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Jano' ba' ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax gu ñi'ook gu chuukug ali' karneer; gio ba' bɨx na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' maa'nkar na jix maa jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax vaik jix bhai'x kakneer.

Gu' gu' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu Lebitas bɨɨx ka'm jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix bhaan; na gu' gu Lebitas chooto'n jix gɨ' gu i'ii'ñ na ba' jix bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨɨx gu vaak na jix bhai' maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' jix duñia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Esekîas bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; na gu' ka't.
Jano' ba' bhañ gio gu Esekîas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu Israeel gu Judaa ua'na gu Epraim gu Manasees gu Jerusalem gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gakdhi'ñchix gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' ka't gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx chiñia' bɨɨx bɨx gu Jerusalem na ba' gakdhi'ñchix gook.
Na gu' na gu' jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' cham ka't jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan tu' gu ja'tkam ka't ju'ñdharan gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' bɨx.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu Israeel dɨr gu Beer-seba bɨɨx ka'm gu Dan na ba' gakdhi'ñchix gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu Jerusalem; na gu' jix jai' gu ñi'ook cham ua'nak.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu jix duñia' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' bɨx gu Israeel gu Judaa na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' ka't jix duñia' am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Israeel gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p tattat na ja'p gu ja'tkam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tattat do'ñcho na ja'p.

Jano' ba' cham moimkada' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p tattat; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook xidhuu tu' na ba' bɨɨx tas; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook i'iich gu ñi'ook.

Na gu' na gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch vupui bhaan namki' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu oidha'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam cham gu ñi'ook gu vupui tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Epraim gu Manasees bɨɨx ka'm gu Sabuloon; gu'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook dhɨt gu chichio'ñ gu Aser gu Manasees gu Sabuloon jix duñia' tɨɨtɨs gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa gio ka't gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix maa gu i'ii'ñ na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam na ba' gook; gio ba' gu masad.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gio bɨx jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' bhi'ñbak gu Kedroon.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gakdhi'ñchix gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas jix bhaan bɨɨx xi'ɨraam aichdhak maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan tu jiim gu ɨ'ɨr gu noobh gu Lebitas.
Na gu' na gu' ka't mui'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham mi'p gu ñi'ook gu Lebitas maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gakdhi'ñchix bɨx cham na ba' jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu Epraim gu Manasees gu Issakâr gu Sabuloon cham koi'mɨk gakdhi'ñchix cham jurtu'nka' ua'nak; gu' gu Esekîas bham; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix bhai' ka't jix duñia' bɨx mii' dhɨr tu' gu i'ii'ñ na ba' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tattat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhaan xidhuu.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu Jawatan Dios gu Esekîas jix duñia' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem gu takarui' cham jabka' kɨɨv gu tanoolh bɨɨx jix gɨ'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu tanoolh gu Lebitas jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx gu kavɨk gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Esekîas gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu Lebitas ko'kmarak jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' koi'mɨk maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan kɨɨv gu tanoolh makgɨrxi'ñdha' jix maa taxchaabgi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tattat.
Jano' ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook.

Na gu' na gu' gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa ka't jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x kɨɨv jix bhai'x kakneer; gio ba' gio chiñia' jix maa gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x kakneer; mi' dhɨr mui'x jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix bhaan.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa na ja'p gio jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bɨx ka't tɨbiap gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix daa tɨbiap gu oidha' gu Israeel oi'ñka' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem; na gu' dɨr gu tanoolh gu Salomoon gu mar gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel cham ka't jix duñia' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu Lebantaandose mi' dhɨr jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas jix bhai' aa' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam soi'm ba'bhak xidhuu gu tɨkɨr.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx dhi' tu'x bɨx gu Israeel gaagam moor jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa jix duñia' dhi' jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bɨx gu Judaa gu Benjamiin gio gu Epraim gu Manasees bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook bɨx; gio ba' mi' dhɨr suulh bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel maa'n gu maa'nkar jɨ'dɨlh.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esekîas jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas jurtu'nka' maa'n bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan na ba' kiki'ñgob gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' ka't maa'nkar tai bhaan gu xibh gu xumai maa'nkar tai bhaan na ba' tas na jix bhaan na ja'p ua'nak ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gio gu ja'tkam jix daa gu Jerusalem gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas na ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' na ja'p dhi' jir bɨx bhai' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix maa mumua'da' kai'ñ suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu i'bhɨ gu oidha'; gio ba' aichdhak boosgi bɨx tu'x gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gio gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Judaa oi'ñka' jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa jix maa boosgi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer; gio ba' aichdhak boosgi tu'x jix daa jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas gɨ' kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik kua'da' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gɨ' kavɨk kɨɨv jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' gu Esekîas chiñia' tɨɨtɨs gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ' kavɨk jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tɨtda:―¿Jax gu Esekîas jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook gɨ' kavɨk.

Ba' jix aa' gu Asariias gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu vaak gu Sadok; gio ba' dɨr kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix jai'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ja'tkam tu' jix duñia' dhi'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Esekîas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam boosgi tu'x; gio ba' jix maa gu Kônaniias gu Lebita gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Simi xibhɨk ka't gook.

Jano' ba' gu Jeiel gu Asasiias gu Naat gu Asael gu Jerimot gu Josabad gu Eliel gu Ismakîas gu Maaat gu Benaiias jix bɨɨx duu daam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Kônaniias gu Simi xibhɨk gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas gu Asariias gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Koree gu mar gu Imna gu Lebita gu ñi'ook tas buusñi ga'ra' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam saba'da' gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar na jix maa gu Jawatan Dios bɨx.

Jano' ba' gu novɨ ka't gu Edeen gu Benjamiin gu Jesua gu Semaiias gu Amariias gu Sekâniias jɨ'dɨlh jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ja'tkam jurtu'nka' jix gɨ' na ja'p jix ali'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ vaik jiix bɨx gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bhaan.
Jano' ba' gio jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan tattat gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook jiix jurtu'nka'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bɨx a'aalh gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bɨx ja'tkam vaak; na gu' bɨɨx tu'x jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan mi'p jɨ'dɨlh bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu chio'ñ ko'kmarak bɨx gu chio'ñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Lebitas.
Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' gu Esekîas bɨx gu Judaa; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai' gu ñi'ook jir bɨx bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kua'da' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ ka't.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios chɨbiapui gu Judaa yooxi' bhaan jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk baakɨi.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Esekîas namkia' gu Sennakêrib gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx chiñia' bɨɨx bhaan suudai' buusñi gu suudai' mi'p mai' kiicham; gio ba'.

Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ jix jai' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx suudai' buusñi jix duu biiñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ bham; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria mumua'da' gu suudai' na pai' dhuuk.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esekîas bɨx vaak jodai tu' gu ñi'ook vaak jodai mai'; gio ba' gu Millo kiicham gu Dabii tu' jix duu mumua'da' u'uux gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Ba' jix aa' jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu ja'tkam tu' jix duu ɨrban ki'ñgob kiicham gu i'ii'ñ bham.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha' tu' ɨɨbhi'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria tu' bɨx bɨɨx jupaabkamu'n; na gu' bɨɨx no'ch bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu' bɨɨx no'ch gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dios; gio ba' gu ja'tkam bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios kua' bhaan gu Lakîs bɨɨx bɨx bɨxchu'x bhañ tu duukam gu Jerusalem na ba' a'ga gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bɨx gu Judaa mi'p gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios; gio ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' mia'n gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esekîas na ba' kɨɨsa' koi'm bhiogi' gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.

Ba' jix aa' cham gu Esekîas tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Judaa gu Jerusalem; gio ba' vupui bhaan dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tattat gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios chɨbɨɨp oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu oidha' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨx gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr chɨbɨɨp tattat gu ja'tkam gu noobh gu Por gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' jano' cham iatgi'ñdha' gu Esekîas tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu'; na tu' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx mii' dhɨr gu ja'tkam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu noobh tattat gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' tu'x tu ñi'ook tu duukam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan tu duukam gu Esekîas.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ua'na gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel ua'rgidhimɨk bhaan bham; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios chɨbɨɨp cham o'dam ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu noobh gu Jawatan Dios gu Esekîas o'dam ñi'ook gu noobh.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem ka't vaak jodai na ba' jix duñia' choo'n na ba' gu ñi'ook kiicham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem na ja'p bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu noobh gu chichio'ñ.
Gu' gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Isaiiyas gu mar gu Amoos gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhañ nobii'ñ naaka'n bɨx jix kavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria; gio ba' bɨɨx xi'ɨraam gu vupui gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr baakɨk vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook ba'k.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Esekîas gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem gu noobh gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu noobh bɨx; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx.
Jano' ba' mui'x aichdhak gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa chutumñigam juana'; gio ba' ka't gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' vupui bhaan bɨx chɨbɨɨp mi' dhɨr dhi'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Esekîas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi'm; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' jix maa nɨi'ñchudat.
Gu' gu' gu Esekîas cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jurtu'nka' xoi'kam ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' va'k gu i'ii'ñ ka't daak bhaan gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Esekîas mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem; gio ba' cham suudai' u'va bhaan daak gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh gu Esekîas.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Esekîas namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' jix duu jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu jodai a'bhar gu ñi'ook bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' kai'ñ suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu'; gio ba' dhi' na ba' bɨx gu vaakax na ba'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kakneer; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu Esekîas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' gu Gioon jiix gu ñi'ook tas gei'ñ kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' ka't gu Esekîas bɨx jix duu.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' gu Babiloonia mɨjɨ na ba' maachim gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ka't mii' dhɨr gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' jix maati' bɨx ka't gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Esekîas xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨx ua'nak ñi'ook na jix aa'dham Jawatan gu Isaiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu mar gu Amoos u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Esekîas bɨɨx tattat gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai'm gu ma'nkam gu Dabii koi'm bɨx gu Judaa gu Jerusalem; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Manasees gu mar.
Na pai' dhuuk gu Doke gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Manasees na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx jixchamaam jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp ka't baas gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Esekîas gu taat ka't jix búup jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Baales tu' jix duñia' bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jerusalem ka't gu tɨɨgɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr gook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai gu ma'nkam gu innom; gio ba' ka't jix maa jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ duñia' cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ba'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' jix dhaas na jax chu'm gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu Salomoon gu mar; gio ba' dhi' gu vaak gu Jerusalem tu' bhaan bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt gu Israeel gu oidha' tu' kapbhai' tattat jix duñia' xoi'kam bɨx tu'x tu' jix duñia' bɨx ñi'ook na tu a'ga ñi'ook kavɨk gu novɨ gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Manasees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Judaa gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Jerusalem na ba' duñia' cham bhai' chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Manasees gu ja'tkam gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios bɨɨx gu Manasees gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bhɨɨk gu Babiloonia.
Gu' gu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tattat.
Jano' ba' dhaibu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't; na gu' jix kai soi'm gu Jerusalem oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Manasees gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr dhi' vaak jodai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham gu Dabii tas gei'ñ gu Gioon ba'k ki'ñgob gu Opel gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x; gio ba' jix dhaas ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bɨx jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't gu kavɨk gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem mai' kiicham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' bhai' ñi'ook; gio ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Judaa gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Manasees soi'm gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bɨx ua'nak gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu soi'm gio gu ñi'ook ka't naak bɨx uañi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook pai' ka't gu ñi'ook tu' duiñxim va'k dhi' tu'x ua'ñix gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Manasees bɨɨx tattat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Amoon gu mar.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Amoon na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook gook jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p ka't gu ñi'ook gu Manasees gu taat; na gu' bɨx duiñxim gu taat gu Manasees ka't gu ñi'ook maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Amoon.
Gu' gu' cham pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu Manasees gu taat; gio ba' va'k uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu duukam gu vaak.
Gu' gu' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' naaka'n bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Amoon; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu Josiiyas gu mar.
Gu' gu' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' naaka'n bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Amoon; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu Josiiyas gu mar.
Na pai' dhuuk gu Oko gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu Josiiyas na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii gu taat cham gu ñi'ook kɨɨ'n tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook kua'da' gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' kua'da' gu Judaa gu Jerusalem tu'.

Jano' ba' jix duu jix duñia' vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Baales tu' bapaalh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tas mi'p tu jiim; gio ba' gio dhi' tu jiim oo' bhaan pai'm maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam o'oo jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu jɨ'dɨlh gu Manasees gu Epraim gu Simeoon bɨɨx ka'm gu Neptalii bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xikoolh.
Jano' ba' na ja'p ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' bɨx duiñxim bɨx gu oidha' gu Israeel gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' mi' dhɨr gu oidha' gu vaak bhañ gu Sapaan gu mar gu Asaliias gu Maasiias gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' kiicham gu Joa gu mar gu Joakâs na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu ilkiias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix maa tuumiñ ka't jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Lebitas nukadham ki'ñgob gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu Manasees gu Epraim bɨx gu Israeel bɨx gu Judaa gu Benjamiin mi' dhɨr gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' kapbhai' gu novɨ duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' daam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix duñia' vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu jodai tɨ'ya' gu u'u na ba' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Jaat gu Abdiias gu Lebitas gu ma'nkam gu Merari; mi' dhɨr gu Sakâriias gu Mesullam gu ma'nkam gu Koat na ba' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu Lebitas bɨx pui'm.
Jano' ba' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jix duñia' daam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Lebitas ka't gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tuumiñ ka't jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu ilkiias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu Moisees.
